# Test data

A small stand-in for `static/data/`, which is generated by the backend and not kept in git. CI copies
it there before running the Playwright tests (`pnpm run test:data`).

- `weather.json`, `sources.json`, `terrain/metadata.json`, `hourly/korab.json`: copies of real
  backend output from 2026-11-14. The tests set their clocks from `issued_utc`, so the age does not matter.
- `basemap/style.json`: an empty base map with the `openmaptiles` source the app's own layers need.
  There are no terrain or base-map tiles, so the map draws only the background.

When the backend changes the shape of these files, copy fresh ones over the old. `backend/tests/test_contract.py`
and `tests/unit/contract.test.ts` fail when they no longer match `backend/contract/models.py`.
